ETH.note: Document states nothing on a civil register to ID link.
Gives refugee ID counts only, no share of the population.
Document states nothing on numbers at birth.
Document states nothing on who operates or owns the ID system.
Document names no public register keyed on the ID number.

facts.fact: UNHCR says that since March 2024 the Ethiopian government has issued digital ID cards to refugees, each with a unique Fayda number to prevent duplication, 9,669 issued by August 2024.
UNHCR says 9,669 refugees had received Fayda-numbered digital ID cards by August 2024, with 25,394 consenting, issued by the government with UNHCR since March 2024.
UNHCR says the refugee digital IDs allow refugees to open bank accounts and give access to mobile connectivity.
